title: Sabhalal le xisne wadih
intro: Kaxxa sabri kee aggiriqqe sinni kibal le num, loowo sinni liggiditteh qibaadah farmo, foocal garuq sinni qaybi kee cinna. ken aydaadi caylale sumaaqa imaan foocal kaxxa kufri, culminating kaxxa tekkooka baadal qagitak weelo.
clues: Anu inni manok kaxxam xer waktih addat yi ummatta Yallih qibaadah seeco abak suge.
Yi ummatta yoo tusuuleh, qellat kee cabut yoo malkisse.
Anu baddi alfime sinni ayyuntah qaadah ane waytam celta xisam amriseh suge.
dubuk dago mari yeemenem kee yoo kee yi buxah marat yengele ta baxsale xisneh.
Yalli elle amrisen innal, kulli rooci leemik nammay takkoh quuke.
kaxxa weeqi ardi yibbixe, dubuk yollih suge mara catteh yi merraytut, yi baxi isi kufrih rabe.
arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
